calibration_rulings.title: map.terrain: how is “3D” said in Urdu, where no Latin letter is allowed (EN “3D terrain map”, AR «الخريطة التضاريسية 3D»)?
calibration_rulings.binds: map.terrain; every later interface string that says “3D” (tmap.* when the terrain page is translated).
calibration_rulings.ruling: C: «تین جہتی» — map.terrain «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ». The on-05 reader’s charge is the condition stage 4 set for the fallback, and between two native words a reader’s stumble is evidence (the restriction of P16 is on loans). C is the plainer of the two, the wording the reference article on maps uses, and needs no Latin letter and no figure. B refused: P16-test (2) is met, but (1) is not (the reference names 3D maps natively, A and C) and (3) is not (no headword); a stumble alone never admits a loan. A withdrawn from this string; it stays a correct headword and is recorded in C’s entry for search. D not taken (technical). Cost: «تین جہتی» has no entry page of its own (both parts are common words; the compound is attested in use). ROUND 2: proofed on r1 (must-fix 0) and read blind on r1; C kept — the second reader’s charge falls on the label’s length and on «نشیب و فراز» (N333), not on «تین جہتی», and «سہ جہتی» cannot return (it was contested by the first reader).
calibration_rulings.guard: Stage checker: none of «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا سہ جہتی نقشہ», «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تھری ڈی نقشہ», «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا سہ ابعادی نقشہ» occurs. For the proofreader, not machine-read: “3D” is «تین جہتی», never the Latin «3D» and never the loan «تھری ڈی». The machine clause bans exactly the three full map.terrain labels this entry withdrew (A), refused (B) or did not take (D), never the word «سہ جہتی» or «تین جہتی» elsewhere.

calibration_rulings.title: map.lead.a: the action clause — “tap any place … to open its card” (AR «واضغط أي معلم … لفتح بطاقته»).
calibration_rulings.binds: map.lead.a (its visible lead and its meta / og / twitter description).
calibration_rulings.ruling: E: the noun of A stands — «اس کا مختصر تعارف کھل جائے گا» (N306: no «کارڈ»; the popup does hold the place’s summary) — and the verb is «چنیں», the everyday verb of the sentence before it and of list.lead, so the lead names the reader’s action with one word. Device-neutral like the Arabic «اضغط». B refused on P16-test (1): a native verb exists (A, E); it also narrows to the mouse as “tap” narrows to touch. The on-05 reader’s «ٹیپ کریں» refused on the same test (0 pages on ur.wikipedia); no dictionary entry was sought for either loan. C refused (N89). D not taken. Cost, charged under accuracy: the Arabic’s two verbs (choose a category / press a place) become one Urdu verb; no native device-neutral verb for “press a link” is in the line’s evidence. ROUND 2: proofed on r1 (must-fix 0); the fresh on-r1 reader confirms E (item 17).
calibration_rulings.guard: Stage checker: none of «فہرست میں یا نقشے پر کسی بھی مقام کو منتخب کریں تو اس کا مختصر تعارف کھل جائے گا۔», «فہرست میں یا نقشے پر کسی بھی مقام پر کلک کریں تو اس کا مختصر تعارف کھل جائے گا۔», «فہرست میں یا نقشے پر کسی بھی مقام کو دبائیں تو اس کا مختصر تعارف کھل جائے گا۔» occurs. For the proofreader, not machine-read: the action clause of map.lead.a is «فہرست میں یا نقشے پر کسی بھی مقام کو چنیں تو اس کا مختصر تعارف کھل جائے گا۔»; «کارڈ» is not written; the loans «ٹیپ کریں» and «کلک کریں» stay barred by P16. The machine clause bans exactly the three full withdrawn or refused sentences of map.lead.a (A, B, C), never the words «منتخب», «انتخاب», «کلک» or «دبائیں», nor any shorter span of these sentences, in a later string.

calibration_rulings.title: map.terrain: the length and wording of the terrain link label.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: «زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا تین جہتی نقشہ» (with N331 C). Both source words kept; «زمین کے» fixes the literal sense of «نشیب و فراز» (relief, not the ups and downs of fortune). B drops that anchor; C coins an unattested term and widens “terrain” to “physical”. ROUND 2: kept against two readers’ moderate charge of register (on-05 5, on-r1 14): both read the label correctly; the sourced entry is not replaced on taste alone, and no plainer attested native phrase for “terrain” is in the evidence. Cost charged under nativeness (three points) and fit (one). Option for the owner and for the batch that translates the terrain page (tmap.*), one line: a plainer native phrase («زمین کی اونچ نیچ», or the reader’s «اونچائی نیچائی»), each needing its own evidence through the line.
calibration_rulings.guard: Stage checker: the string «سہ جہتی طبعی نقشہ» does not occur. For the proofreader, not machine-read: the terrain link label keeps «زمین کے» before «نشیب و فراز», and is not «تین جہتی طبعی نقشہ» either (C with N331’s word; never a wording of the chain, so not in the machine clause). The machine clause bans exactly candidate C’s full label as the chain proposed it, never «طبعی نقشہ» elsewhere.
